mode: bounded read-only feasibility after all previous evaluations seen
sample_selection: A/B first official train RGB plus each scene first,middle,last available metadata row; 14 unique states frozen before inference
preprocess: full image resize bilinear to224 square, ImageNet normalization; uses16x16 patches; previous pipeline padded84px wrist into224 giving ~6x6 effective content, so this is not directly interchangeable with old head inputs
matching: mean normalized descriptor of patches with centres inside assistant template part box; two A/B templates perpart; maximum cosine template similarity over every candidate patch; report unconditional top1 and spatially distant runner-up, no validated threshold
camera_transfer: static handle reference and wrist finger reference each applied to both cameras; correspondence not ground truth
no_object_boxes_from_matching: a matching point is not an instance boundary or identity guarantee
context_probe: four reference part boxes: compare pooled full-image tokens original vs gray outside selected14x14patches after resizing, preserving selected input patches exactly, and separately re-encoded identical local crops; no label scoring
budget: one frozen inference pass over28 originals+4 outside-gray variants+8 local crops=40RGB tensors, no sweeps, no retries unless execution error
